The '''Virgillian Council''' was the government of the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]] established after the end of the [[Virgillian Civil War]],<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="4 ABY" /> Its formation was part of the truce established between the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]] and the [[Aristocracy]], the two opposing sides of the civil war, after the Free Alignment's victory.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

The Council ordered two of the [[Virgillian Free Alignment Starfleet]] modified [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruisers]] to assist the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. The Virgillian [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was sent to the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]], where the Alliance was rendezvousing for a battle in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. After Endor, the [[Starship|ships]] followed the rest of the Alliance fleet to investigate an [[Bakura Incident|incident]] in the [[Bakura system/Legends|Bakura system]]. The Council also ordered one of the Free Alignment's [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruisers]] to remain in the Virgillia [[Star system/Legends|system]] in case of retaliatory [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attacks on Virgillian military bases.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Virgillian Council was first mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] guide published in [[1996]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book was written by [[Kathy Tyers]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />
